faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Begusarai Support Person recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the DCPU Begusarai Support Person recruitment is 15 days from the notification date, which is 24 April 2026. Therefore, applications must be submitted by 9 May 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in MSW, Sociology, Psychology, Child Development, or Law, or a Diploma in Child Rights/Counseling along with any Graduate degree and at least 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 30 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years. The age will be calculated as of 01 June 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Support Person role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Support Person position will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 9000 per case, paid in three installments.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Support Person post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies announced for the Support Person position in the District Child Protection Unit Begusarai.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Support Person position?
faq.answer: The Support Person position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
